subject: Demo scheduling: US to EU follow-up rotation & DST note
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lincoln <sarah.lincoln@olivehealth.com>; Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo scheduling: US to EU follow-up rotation & DST note

Hi Sarah -- thanks again for taking the time today. Quick follow-up on next steps and a proposed cadence for the follow-up call with our EU team.

We want to coordinate a short 30-min follow-up next week to review the API integration checklist and SLA questions. Two windows that should work for your team and allow Lauren (our EU AE) to join in her morning are:
- Option A: Wed 2026-09-22, 09:30 CEST / Tue 2026-09-21, 00:30 PDT (not ideal west coast)
- Option B: Thu 2026-09-23, 11:00 CEST / Thu 2026-09-23, 02:00 PDT

I realize those are late for US stakeholders — we can do a handoff: I’ll run the initial demo for your engineering lead during US hours and Lauren will pick up the follow-up in EU morning the next day. Important note: EU DST ends Oct 25 and US DST ends Nov 1 this year, so if we tentatively schedule recurring weekly follow-ups that cross that window we’ll need to confirm times in late Oct.

Attached: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (draft) and a quick timezone-cheatsheet.pdf that highlights the DST mismatch week.

Would either of the above windows work for you? If neither, tell me a 2-hour window in CEST that’s preferred and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Vivek
SDR, Redwood Inference
P: +1 415-555-0158
From: Sarah Lincoln <sarah.lincoln@olivehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 20:47:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling: US to EU follow-up rotation & DST note

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the windows and the heads-up about DST.

Option A is pretty early for our engineering lead (they're UK-based and can stretch to ~09:00 BST). Option B at 11:00 CEST works for our PM and engineering if Lauren can join.

Two quick asks: can you confirm the agenda for that 30-min follow-up (we want to allocate time for security questions), and can you send a calendar invite for Option B so it lands in our calendars?

Best,
Sarah
Principal Product Manager 
Olive Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 21:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling: US to EU follow-up rotation & DST note

Vivek — quick internal note so we're aligned before we send the invite to Sarah: Lauren prefers standing 30-min follow-ups at 11:00 CEST (that’s 02:00 PDT), but she can do this once next week if we rotate who takes the late US demo.

Thoughts on a rotation: Vivek runs the US hours demo (US stakeholder-facing) and Lauren leads the EU follow-up on M/W/F next week? If we commit to weekly cadence crossing the DST-change window later in Oct, we should add a one-off calendar reminder in late Oct to confirm times.

Also, I can add an agenda section in the invite: 1) API integration checklist (10m), 2) Security & data handling (10m), 3) Next steps / PoC timeline (10m).

-Kim
Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

To: Sarah Lincoln <sarah.lincoln@olivehealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 01:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling: US to EU follow-up rotation & DST note

Thanks Kim and Sarah — I’ll send the invite for Option B (Thu 2026-09-23 11:00 CEST / 02:00 PDT). Agenda will be exactly as Kim outlined; I’ll include the security checklist as an attachment and flag the items we want answers for ahead of time.

Quick note for tracking: I’ve created a deal task in HubSpot (RDW-4983) and added a reminder to verify recurring meeting times during the DST transition week (Oct 25 - Nov 1).

Sending invite now.

Vivek

Got the invite and agenda — confirmed for Thu 11:00 CEST. I added our security lead (cc'ed) to the calendar. Thanks for flagging the DST window.

One small ask: can you include a note in the invite title about "EU follow-up / security" so it's clear in our calendars (we triage by title).

See you Thursday.

Sarah
